name: v2.5.21
body:
## What's new in v2.5.21

- chore(telemetria): via anche il server beta-telemetry, non ha più nessun mittente
- refactor(debug): via la cattura HAR e perf, non la avviava più nessuno
- feat(sito): screenshot della beta e nota sulla reinstallazione, al posto del riquadro Debian 13
- feat(sito): il sito pubblico diventa quello della beta, senza telemetria
- feat(privacy): la telemetria della beta privata sparisce dal dispositivo
- chore(ci): via il workflow remote-support-mint
- Update SECURITY.md
- feat: drop the macOS build and send Mac users to balenaEtcher
- fix(website): the download button now really disappears when macOS is selected
- fix(website): repair the broken script that left every download button dead
- fix(website): move the LyrPlay recommendation to the beta site, with a QR code
- feat(website): macOS gets two Terminal commands instead of a download button
- docs(website): recommend LyrPlay for iPhone and iPad, clearly as a third party
- feat(website): macOS is back, downloaded from Terminal so it is never quarantined
- feat(website): drop the macOS builds from the download options for now
- fix(website): the macOS note described a button that never appears
- feat(website): lead with the app, keep the ISO as the fallback, explain the gate
- fix(website): say the app is unsigned without making anyone click for it
- feat(website): choose the ISO or the app for your OS from a dropdown
- ci(flasher): keep main's registered workflow copy in step with svil
- fix(ci): the Intel macOS job needs macos-15-intel, not macos-15
- ci(flasher): keep main's registered copy of the workflow in step with svil
- fix(ci): the flasher build no longer dies when the version is unchanged
- ci(flasher): register build-flasher.yml on main so it can be dispatched
- chore(website): the beta page points at the dev.114 ISO
- feat(website): beta page announces the Debian 13 jump, ISO to dev113
- fix(website): remove DSP section from the manual
- fix(website): use a shorter 16:9 box for the beta demo video
- fix(website): fix the beta video box actually being square
- feat(website): point beta ISO download at dev.111
- fix(website): make the beta page video embed square
- feat(website): embed YouTube demo video on the beta landing page
- feat(website): put email and GitHub Issues side by side as support channels
- Revert "feat(website): highlight email and GitHub Issues as support channels"
- feat(website): highlight email and GitHub Issues as support channels
- feat(website): point beta ISO download at dev.108 (R2)
- feat(website): point beta ISO download at dev.107 (R2)
- docs(privacy): telemetry server now runs on a self-hosted homelab, not Oracle Cloud
- docs(privacy): clarify HAR captures strip auth/session data and never see other traffic
- feat(website): point beta ISO download at R2 instead of GitHub Releases
- chore(website): update beta site screenshots
- fix(website): rename beta consent checkbox away from ad-blocker-flagged id/class
- feat(website): add support section explaining email-to-GitHub-issue
- feat(website): gate the ISO download behind a privacy-notice checkbox
- docs(privacy): drop the restrict/stop-processing right
- docs(privacy): drop the supervisory-authority complaint mention
- docs(privacy): note the data collector is removed at first prod release
- docs(privacy): the only guaranteed way to avoid sharing data is a wipe
- docs(privacy): drop unoffered correction/deletion right, clarify stop-processing
- docs(privacy): clarify hosting/device-label wording, drop dead opt-out mention
- feat(website): remove changelog section from the beta site
- fix(website): trim beta changelog down to the last 2 dev releases
- fix(website): drop unverifiable prod version labels from beta changelog
- fix(website): relabel beta changelog with dev release tags
- feat(website): remove changelog section from the prod site
- fix(website): anchor carousel counter/nav to the carousel image
- chore: gitignore a local-only manual-deploy cheat sheet
- fix(website): correct leftover stale carousel refs after beta screenshot swap
- Aggiornato index.html con link ISO v2.5.21-dev.104
- Aggiornato index.html con link ISO v2.5.21-dev.104
- fix(website): point the manual callout at the new /beta/manual path
- fix(website): move the manual to /beta/manual instead of site root
- feat(website): publish the manual on /beta, warn about Secure Boot, fix contact/domain
- feat(website): private /beta site pointing to dev-channel builds + GDPR privacy notice
- feat(website): add password-protected /beta section
- Delete .github/dependabot.yml
- Delete .github/workflows/fortify.yml
- Update fortify.yml
- Create fortify.yml
- Update README.md
- ci(dependabot): add config targeting svil for version updates
- ci(pages): deploy via Actions instead of relying on the legacy Pages builder
- fix(ci): install age explicitly in remote-support-mint.yml
- ci: add remote-support-mint.yml workflow (main-only, no app changes)
